purpose: Select one finite historical-only Campaign062 mechanism from frozen definitions and source schemas before reading any Campaign062 quarterly row, candidate value, comparison value, daily price, or forward return.

candidate_design_catalog.reason: The statistic isolates cross-issuer attention competition for one standardized quarterly report event. It is not the issuer's announcement age, announcement delay, multi-quarter delay consistency, accounting value, or same-issuer event multiplicity.
All monotone transforms would preserve daily ranks. The exact reciprocal count is frozen for interpretability and bounded validation.
Mixing different report periods would turn the mechanism into generic disclosure traffic. Peers must share both exact report_date and exact announcement_date.
No industry, board, size, accounting-value, or quality-conditioned peer subsets are admitted.
Campaign020, Campaign032, and Campaign052 already terminalized the issuer-time families. Campaign062 changes only when the number of same-event-date peer issuers changes.
Campaign062 contains one direct disclosure-identity statistic and loads no terminal score into its formula.

selected_candidate.name: quarterly_announcement_peer_crowding_sparsity
selected_candidate.economic_hypothesis: A quarterly report disclosed on a less crowded same-report-period announcement date faces less cross-issuer attention competition, so its firm-specific information may diffuse more persistently from the next open through the third close.
selected_candidate.formula: For every unique instrument-report_date event, count distinct instruments sharing its exact report_date and announcement_date in the frozen source. For each stock-day, select the latest event effective on the first accepted session strictly after announcement_date, breaking simultaneous effective events by later report_date, and return 1/peer_count.
selected_candidate.peer_group: exact report_date and exact announcement_date across distinct instruments in the immutable quarterly source
selected_candidate.availability_rule: announcement_date must be strictly earlier than the stock-day; effectiveness begins on the first accepted local session after announcement_date
selected_candidate.simultaneous_effective_event_rule: choose the event with the greatest report_date, then greatest announcement_date
selected_candidate.score_rule: one divided by the positive integer peer count including the issuer itself

decision.next_action: Complete a separate mechanism-overlap audit before freezing the exact no-return protocol or reading source values.
